description: The native commands installed Whispering (app id so.epicenter.whispering) uses, granted to its windows by app id: every label open_installed_window makes for that id, with or without a folder. It records into the folder its window was granted (ADR-0543), transcribes with the one active local model and reads whether that model is ready (ADR-0180), opens Settings where that model is chosen, and sends its transcription and text requests over its AI connections with the key this computer saved, which it never reads (ADR-0557). Opening its window also permits it into so.epicenter, whose connections table holds those connections. The folder plugin comes from installed-app-windows. Approving an app trusts it fully (ADR-0540), so this is wiring, not a sandbox: it lists what the app calls, and nothing it does not.
